title: Google Calendar
subtitle: Show church events and room usage in your church's Google Calendar.
notConfigured: Google is not set up on this server yet. Ask whoever runs your Gembala server to add the Google credentials.
connectBody: Gembala creates its own calendars in that account and keeps them up to date. It cannot see or change any other calendar.
connectedToast: Google Calendar connected. Choose what to sync.
connectError: Could not connect Google Calendar. Try again, and allow calendar access when Google asks.
feedsHint: Each option is a separate calendar in Google. Share it from Google Calendar with the people who should see it.
eventsHint: Every event, including ones not marked public.
roomsHint: Events that have a room, titled with the room name.
turnOffHint: Turning an option off deletes its calendar from Google.
oneWay: Sync is one way: changes made in Google are overwritten by Gembala.
synced: Google Calendar is up to date.
disconnectConfirm: Disconnect and delete the Gembala calendars from Google?
